Source_Title: Exhibition board 'Pengubahsuaian Simple Tachyometric Director (STD) Kepada Anjungan Latihan'
Author_or_Organisation: On-board exhibition, KD Hang Tuah (producer not stated)
Document_Reference: Board in the junior rates' dining hall; photographed by the project on board KD Hang Tuah, 30 September 2026. Includes a profile drawing, a front photograph of the training bridge and a top-view sketch of the converted STD compartment.
Rights_Status: Board content belongs to its producer. Photograph unpublished.
Verification_Notes: Secondary source. Its statements are recorded as 'Stated on the exhibition board': the STD was located on top of the bridge; from 1998 a proposal was made to convert the STD structure into a training bridge; the sketch shows three forward windows, two windows on each side, a chart table, a step ladder, a hatch for the deck head and doors at the after end, with lengths read as 2000 (extended) and 3600 (existing). The figures on the sketch are blurred in the photograph.
